query: SELECT f.name, ffs.searchFee, ffs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee, ffs.minPropertyValue, ffs.maxPropertyValue FROM firm_fee_structures ffs JOIN law_firms f ON f.id = ffs.firmId ORDER BY f.name, ffs.minPropertyValue LIMIT 30;
